note: Nov 11 training tour (presentation/Nov11_run_of_show.md): the seven stops of the run of show, about 30 min. Chapters = the sec values; the viewer's chapter bar (and keys 1-7) jumps to the first stop of each. Cameras as in tour.json.

stops.title: A 3x1 gas power campus, from fuel to the grid
stops.eq: Three gas turbines, three HRSGs, one steam turbine; modular yard, battery storage, a behind-the-meter data centre, LNG
stops.sys: About 1.6 GW of combined cycle plus modular generation; conceptual, sized like real US plants
stops.cab: About 6,000 cable runs and 6.4 million ft in the model's cable schedule

stops.title: 230 kV breaker-and-a-half switchyard
stops.eq: Circuit breakers, disconnects, CTs and VTs, line take-off gantries
stops.sys: Two breakers per circuit: any breaker can be maintained without an outage
stops.cab: CT / VT and breaker control cable in trench to the relay house; ACSR overhead conductor to the utility

stops.title: Generator step-up transformers
stops.eq: Three 21/230 kV GSUs with firewalls, HV bushings, surge arresters, take-off gantries
stops.sys: Each unit's generator is stepped up to 230 kV and taken overhead to the switchyard
stops.cab: CT, alarm and cooling-control cable in Type TC-ER; deluge fire-protection wiring; MV-105 to the unit transformers

stops.title: Gas turbine and generator
stops.eq: H-class gas turbine and hydrogen-cooled generator on the EL 20 turbine deck
stops.sys: The generator makes power at about 21 kV (typical for this class)
stops.cab: Instrument, control and lube-oil skid cables drop from the overhead tray to the skids

stops.title: Isolated-phase bus to the step-up transformer
stops.eq: Isolated-phase bus, generator circuit breaker, unit auxiliary transformer tap, GSU
stops.sys: About 11 kA per phase at 21 kV leaves the generator; the GSU steps it up to 230 kV
stops.cab: No cable on the main path: at these currents it is bus duct. Cable starts at the taps

stops.title: R1: 13.8 kV and 4.16 kV switchgear
stops.eq: Metal-clad switchgear lineups across the operating aisle, MCCs, protection and control panels
stops.sys: The plant runs on its own power: unit auxiliary transformers feed 13.8 kV, then 4.16 kV and 480 V
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV and 5 kV to motors and transformers; Type TC-ER 600 V power and control

stops.title: HRSG 1: from the e-house to the marshalling box
stops.eq: HRSG casing, EL 42 control and instrument tray, marshalling box
stops.sys: Hundreds of transmitters, valves and thermocouples per HRSG, marshalled locally
stops.cab: Instrumentation PLTC / TC-ER shielded pairs, thermocouple extension, RTD triads

stops.title: Inside the HRSG e-house
stops.eq: T-R2A 2,500 kVA, LC-R2A 480 V switchgear, two MCCs, VFDs, DCS marshalling, UPS and 125 V DC
stops.sys: 13.8 kV in, 480 V out to every motor, valve and heater on the HRSG; the DCS I/O for the train
stops.cab: MV-105 primary, 40 x 500 kcmil secondary, TC-ER drops into every bucket, instrument home runs; one HRSG train = 707 cables, ~157,000 ft

stops.title: The stack and the CEMS shelter
stops.eq: Stack probes at EL 103, heated sample line, walk-in analyzer shelter (NOx, CO, O2, NH3 slip)
stops.sys: Continuous emissions monitoring: the data that keeps the plant in compliance
stops.cab: TC-ER power, PLTC instrument pairs, FPLR fire alarm, fibre to the control room; ~31 cables per shelter

stops.title: Top of the stack
stops.eq: Red aviation obstruction lights, lighting junction box and photocell, lightning air terminals
stops.sys: Lights fed from the e-house with a failure alarm to the DCS; bare-copper down conductors to the ground grid
stops.cab: TC-ER up 180 ft of conduit, a control cable for the alarm, bare copper grounding

stops.title: Boiler Row: three boilers, three cable stories
stops.eq: Gas package boiler AB-1, a 300 MW-class gas-fired utility boiler with its steam-turbine hall, a 30 MW electrode boiler with its 13.8 kV e-house
stops.sys: Package: start-up steam. Utility: new for AI campuses or converted from coal. Electric: steam from power, no flame and no stack
stops.cab: Package: control-dense, factory pre-wired. Utility: ~1,800 cables, two-thirds instrument footage, ARMOR-X MC-HL at every burner. Electric: 1,255 A at 13.8 kV, 18 MV-105 750 kcmil

stops.title: The air-cooled condenser
stops.eq: 80 fan cells on a raised deck, steam ducts and street risers, wind wall, stair towers
stops.sys: Dry cooling: the steam turbine exhaust is condensed by air, so the plant needs no cooling-tower water
stops.cab: VFD cable from the R4 drives to every fan motor, up the street risers in tray

stops.title: R4: the air-cooled condenser fan drives
stops.eq: Two lineups of variable-frequency drives, output trays overhead
stops.sys: One 480 V drive per fan, 80 fans on the air-cooled condenser
stops.cab: VFD cable: three symmetrical grounds and an overall shield, to contain common-mode noise

stops.title: The modular power yard
stops.eq: RICE engine hall, simple-cycle units, aeroderivatives, fuel cells, microturbines, the PCM and MOD-EH
stops.sys: Fast-start capacity on its own 13.8 kV collector, beside the combined cycle
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV collector feeders in tray and duct bank to MOD-EH

stops.title: RICE engine hall
stops.eq: Eight 18-cylinder gas engines in one hall: exhaust trains, SCRs, 90 ft stacks, radiators
stops.sys: Reciprocating engine-generators: fast start, high part-load efficiency, little water
stops.cab: MV-105 generator leads; ARMOR-X MC on strut to the radiator fan disconnects

stops.title: Simple-cycle aeroderivative units
stops.eq: Two LM6000-class units: inlet filter house, turbine enclosure, SCR, 80 ft stack
stops.sys: Peaking power in about ten minutes from start; 13.8 kV generators onto the collector
stops.cab: MV-105 generator leads; Type TC-ER control; ARMOR-X MC-HL in the fuel-gas skid

stops.title: Battery energy storage
stops.eq: Battery containers, PCS / MV skids, DC trenches, collector feeders
stops.sys: Rides through load steps and supports the grid in seconds
stops.cab: 2 kV DC conductors in the trench; MV-105 35 kV aluminium collector circuits

stops.title: A data-centre campus behind the meter
stops.eq: About 150 MW of IT load: two data halls, rooftop dry coolers, 36 backup gensets, a 40 MW / 80 MWh BESS
stops.sys: Supplied from the modular yard; the grid tie is normally open
stops.cab: 13.8 kV cable bus from MOD-EH to the step-ups; 34.5 kV distribution to the halls

stops.title: Three ways to power the campus
stops.eq: 13.8 / 34.5 kV step-ups, the 230 kV tie, switchgear and the BTM battery
stops.sys: 1 islanded gensets and battery · 2 from the modular yard · 3 grid tie, normally open
stops.cab: MV-105 35 kV feeders; HV XLPE on the 230 kV tie

stops.title: The gas yard: Class I, Division 2
stops.eq: Metering, regulation, performance heater, filter-separators
stops.sys: Fuel gas makes this a classified area: every entry is sealed
stops.cab: Rigid conduit with EYS seals, and ARMOR-X MC-HL run exposed on strut

stops.title: LNG: one rack, into the e-house roof
stops.eq: LNG e-house, MC-HL rack to the send-out pumps, reel roller, sheave, capstan
stops.sys: Send-out pump power and controls, with a roof entry into the e-house
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL pulled from the reel; intrinsically safe instrument cable (blue jacket)

stops.sec: Wire and cable · the whole campus
stops.title: Every megawatt travels through a cable
stops.eq: One campus, from the gas turbine to the grid and the data centre
stops.sys: Power, control, instrumentation, fire alarm and fibre
stops.cab: About 1,120 miles of cable, mapped on its route
